messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — PagerDuty triggered for HALO-enterprise (customer: Halo Financial). p99 latency exceeded SLO in eu-central-1. Current p99: 2.1s (SLO: 1.2s). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Pager: oncall-sre.
sre-bot: Auto-scale attempted +2 nodes, but dedicated pool at capacity (12/12).
alex_crane: on it, taking incident lead. @maria_ng please handle customer comms and CS handoff.
maria_ng: acknowledged — DMing Halo, posting status page: "Investigating increased latency in eu-central affecting Halo Financial. Mitigations in progress."
jonah_k: initial signals look like tenant amplification from Halo — lots of concurrent long-context requests. High KV cache miss rate and GPU CPU-steal on a subset of nodes.
alex_crane: action plan (isolation playbook): 1) apply tenant-level throttling 2) route part of Halo traffic to warm spare in eu-west-1 3) evict noisy background jobs if needed. @priya_s can you run tenant isolation script?
priya_s: running: `./tools/isolate_tenant.sh --tenant halo --mode throttle --rate 70% --dry-run=no`
incident-bot: EXEC: tenant isolation command completed. Throttling applied at 70%. Warm-spare reroute initiated.
alex_crane: verify reroute command sent: `send-route --from eu-central-1 --to eu-west-1 --tenant halo --weight 0.5`
priya_s: reroute applied. Observability: tail logs — KV cache miss for Halo dropped 0.86 -> 0.24 after throttle.
jonah_k: p99 for other tenants in eu-central improved to ~1.15s, Halo still ~1.8s on eu-west while warm nodes finish loading.
maria_ng: customer update sent: "We applied throttling and routed part of traffic to eu-west-1. Expect improvements within 15-30m. We will update in 10."
alex_crane: paging PD to re-evaluate dedicated pool size for Halo — finance flagged potential SLA credit.
luke_cs: Halo replied — wants ETA and escalation path. Offered daily follow-up and asked about pre-authorized scaling for their pool. CC @maria_ng
priya_s: starting warm node startup in eu-west-1, job id job_8843. Logs: model shard load ~0.2s/shard, warming KV cache.
jonah_k: note: we observed a kernel/path mismatch on eu-west quantized ops causing slower perf — contacting runtime team to confirm kernel selection.
alex_crane: timeline record: 00:00 detection -> 00:03 throttling -> 00:08 partial reroute -> 00:20 warm nodes online. Target: Halo p99 <1.2s within 45m. Handoff to @maria_ng at +30.
maria_ng: acknowledged, taking monitoring and customer liaison. Alex please leave notes and updates in-thread.
incident-bot: Incident metadata updated: name=halo-enterprise-euc-latency-escalation severity=SEV2 incident-commander=alex_crane warroom=#incidents
alex_crane: additional mitigation — apply temporary quota for long-context requests (>=2048 tokens) for Halo: `redwoodctl quota set --tenant halo --longctx 20`
priya_s: quota applied.
jonah_k: metrics update: overall p99 now ~1.18s; Halo p99 down to ~1.05s on eu-central after warm nodes fully online. Verifying stability.
maria_ng: scheduled customer call +40 to review state and next steps. I'll join with engineering.
alex_crane: runbook checklist: monitor for 1h, post-mortem owner = jonah_k, consider increasing reserved pool size or adjusting autoscale policy as follow-up. Objections?
jonah_k: none, will own post-mortem and run evaluation on KV/cache tuning.
maria_ng: customer-facing summary drafted and queued for send after call.
incident-bot: Incident resolved — p99 restored within SLO for Halo and cluster. Auto-close scheduled in 2h unless re-opened.
